answer: An agent marketplace handling saffron orders and terrace trellis repairs can require each seller identity to lock a bond for 30 days before accepting work, with the bond forfeited if a signed delivery receipt is proven forged. Creating aliases then multiplies the capital an attacker must immobilize: 1,000 active fake sellers require 1,000 bonds, and each detected forgery burns another bond. Renaming an agent cannot recover its locked funds.
